column5: Designer gap-list of per-game cover art, Desktop + Mobile per game. All seven are exported and in the repo: plinko, crash, dice, scratchers, blackjack, coin-flip, mines .webp under skai-gaming assets/games/figma (19 files incl. hilo, towers, chicken). One responsive asset serves both the Desktop and Mobile frames - DiceGame.tsx:80 notes it is "the same exported asset the casino grid tile uses". NOTE the art lives in the skai-gaming SUBMODULE, not public/assets/games in the main repo; git ls-files on the main repo misses it and makes dice look absent
